manifest.name: dsh-cost-guard
manifest.description: Live, local cost estimates for DeepSeek Harness: a compact composer cost pill with details on demand, editable pricing, and per-model totals.

bundle.text:

# The browser half is declared by `dsh.client` in package.json and loaded by
# the client module system from the same package.
- insert:
    - id: cost-guard
      name: 'dsh-cost-guard'

Know what every DSH task costs while it runs. `dsh-cost-guard` is a local-only Cordis plugin bundle for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) that turns recorded token usage into a compact cost pill beside the composer, per-model totals, and editable pricing. Click the pill for the token mix and session total; the dock stays quiet.

It observes execution; it never blocks, reroutes, or changes the agent.

**[Visit the project website →](https://chenzhiyong1994.github.io/dsh-cost-guard/?lang=en)** — explore the cost pill and pricing screenshots, switch between English and Chinese, and copy the installation prompt. Hosted on **GitHub Pages**, with automatic deployment from `main`. See [website maintenance and publishing](docs/website.md).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Token counts come from DSH usage events. Currency amounts are local estimates calculated from your configured rates, not authoritative billing data. Provider prices can change—always treat the provider invoice as the source of truth.

readme.section: One quiet pill, details on demand
readme.text: The composer dock shows a compact `¥` amount for the current or most recent task. Click it for the model, input/output/cache tokens, model-call count, rate window, and session total—without opening another panel or repeating the composer's existing token and cache readings.

readme.section: Pricing and totals stay under your control
readme.text:
Edit model rates, add custom models, apply the official peak/off-peak schedule, inspect per-model totals, and export or import the configuration from **Settings → Cost Guard**.

> The screenshots were captured from an earlier v4.3 instance and still show the old full-width bar. Release `v5.1.0` uses the compact pill and the 2026-10-28 official rates described below; the images will be refreshed after the next capture.

- **Actual usage, not prompt-size guessing** — reads `inputTokens`, `outputTokens`, `cacheReadTokens`, and `cacheWriteTokens` from DSH session events, including retried or interrupted attempts.
- **Live and glanceable** — keeps the current task cost beside the composer; click for the token mix and session total.
- **Subagent-aware** — rolls subagent usage into the active root-session turn, priced with the model that actually served each call.
- **Restart-resilient** — rebuilds a session from its persisted log the first time it is viewed, so history survives plugin restarts.
- **Pricing you can audit** — all model rates and the peak/off-peak windows are visible and editable.
- **Bilingual UI** — the pill and settings page follow the DSH language setting (中文 / English) automatically.
- **Local-only** — no telemetry, external service, account access, or API key collection.
- **Zero execution interference** — no prediction gate, approval overlay, or model routing.

`dsh-cost-guard` is a Cordis **bundle**: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (the Host row) and `dsh.client` (the browser half). Install it the way DSH installs any bundle:

1. Put this repository somewhere stable on disk, for example `D:\plugins\dsh-cost-guard`.
2. Open **Settings → Plugins → Bundles** (插件 → 组合包) in DSH and install from the local directory, or run the CLI equivalent:

```sh
   dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "D:\plugins\dsh-cost-guard"
   ```

3. Restart DSH when the installer reports `restart-required`.

Ask your DSH agent instead, if you prefer:

```text
Install the DSH bundle at D:\plugins\dsh-cost-guard into the current profile,
then confirm the cost-guard row is active in the plugin inventory.
```

The plugin then appears as **Cost Guard** in the plugin inventory and as a top-level **Settings → Cost Guard** page, with a compact cost pill below the composer. No build step is required: both halves are plain JavaScript.
For local development against a checkout, the same command accepts the checkout path directly and links it instead of copying it.

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1+` (Desktop or `dsh web`), with a profile that includes the Web app bundle.
- DSH Web UI for the pill and settings panel.
- Node.js is only needed to run `npm run check` during development.

The `v5.1.0` defaults match the official DeepSeek V4.1 Flash / V4 Pro peak/off-peak pricing verified on **2026-10-28** against the [DeepSeek API pricing page](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/) and the [2026-09-10 price update](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/updates/). Rates are CNY per 1M tokens, off-peak (valley) prices:

| Model | Input · cache miss | Output | Input · cache hit |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `deepseek-flash` | ¥1.00 | ¥4.00 | ¥0.02 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | ¥4.50 | ¥13.50 | ¥0.15 |
| `default` fallback | ¥1.00 | ¥4.00 | ¥0.02 |

Peak hours are 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, on Monday–Friday only, billed at ×2 the off-peak price. Weekends and Chinese statutory holidays are off-peak all day; the 2026 holiday dates are built in. Peak/off-peak pricing is **on by default**; toggle it and edit the windows from the settings page.

Cache-write tokens use the cache-miss input rate because the official table has no separate cache-write item. Old model names still found in session logs are mapped to the current rows: `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` → `deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-reasoner` → `deepseek-v4-pro`; the retired `deepseek-chat` alias also maps to Flash.
Search / Fetch calls are billed separately by DeepSeek (¥5 per 1,000 successful requests from 2026-11-01). Cost Guard does not include those request fees; its numbers cover model tokens only.

```mermaid flowchart LR A["session/event
turn/start · request/context"] --> B["session/event
assistant/message · assistant/attempt"] B --> C["Configured rates
calculate estimate"] C --> D["Turn and model totals"]

- **Host half** (`index.js`) injects `webServer`, folds durable session events, attributes usage to turns, rolls up subagents, backfills a session from its log on first look, and serves two data routes plus a health probe.
- **Client half** (`client.js`) is a `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle that registers the cost pill in `conversation.composer.dock` and the configuration UI in `settings.section`, and reads the Host through `fetch`.
- **Data flow** stays inside the running DSH process; the routes are plain localhost HTTP with no network egress.
- **Pricing state** is persisted to `~/.dsh/cost-guard/config.json` (`$DSH_HOME` aware), so rates survive restarts.

| Section | Controls |
| --- | --- |
| Model pricing | Cache-miss input, output, and cache-hit input rates; custom models; restore defaults (two-step confirm) |
| Peak/off-peak pricing | Weekday windows (09:00–12:00, 14:00–18:00 Beijing) at ×2, excluding built-in 2026 statutory holidays; weekends/holidays off-peak |
| Run totals | Settled turns, actual spend, editable CNY/USD rate, and per-model totals |
| Backup | Export or import the configuration as JSON |
The USD amount in the cost popover is an approximate conversion using the editable CNY/USD rate. All UI text follows the DSH language setting (中文 / English).

A bundle is replaced as a whole. Update by installing the new directory version:

1. Replace the files in the directory you installed from (or pull the new release).
2. Reinstall the bundle from **Settings → Plugins**, or run `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <path>` again.
3. Restart DSH when the installer reports `restart-required`; the Host half and the browser bundle are both reloaded from the new files.

- No outbound requests, telemetry, credential reads, or API key storage.
- The Host observes DSH session usage events and replays persisted session events to reconstruct totals.
- Imported configuration is validated before it replaces the active settings.
- Review third-party plugin source before installing it, especially because DSH plugin interfaces are still evolving.

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for reporting guidance.

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`index.js`](index.js) | Host half: session folding, pricing, HTTP routes |
| [`client.js`](client.js) | Client half: cost pill and settings page bundle |
| [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) | Bundle patch that inserts the Host row |
| [`locale/`](locale) | Display metadata (title/description) for the plugin inventory |
| [`icon.svg`](icon.svg) | Plugin icon |
| [`docs/install.md`](docs/install.md) | Installation, verification, and removal |
| [`docs/index.html`](docs/index.html) | Bilingual project homepage on GitHub Pages |
| [`docs/website.md`](docs/website.md) | Website preview, maintenance, and deployment |
| [`scripts/check.cjs`](scripts/check.cjs) | Bundle-layout, syntax, and release-invariant checks |
| [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) | Release history |

```sh
npm run check
```

The check imports the Host module, compiles the Client bundle as a script, and verifies the bundle manifest, the patch, the exported display metadata, and the release facts. Install the checkout directly to try a change: reinstalling a linked bundle reloads both halves after a DSH restart.
Contributions are welcome—please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). If the plugin saves you from token-bill surprises, consider starring the repository so other DSH users can find it.

This plugin depends on DSH services and UI slots (`webServer`, `sessions`, `session/event`, `conversation.composer.dock`, `settings.section`). They are not guaranteed stable APIs. Include your DSH version when reporting compatibility problems.

在任务执行过程中看清每一分钱花在哪里。`dsh-cost-guard` 是为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 编写的本地 Cordis 插件包（bundle）：它把 DSH 记录的真实 token 用量转换成输入框下方的一枚紧凑价格标签，点开即可看 token 构成与会话累计，同时提供按模型统计和可编辑价格表。

插件只旁路观察，不会拦截、改写或路由 Agent 的执行。

**[访问项目主页 →](https://chenzhiyong1994.github.io/dsh-cost-guard/)** — 查看价格标签与价格设置截图、切换中英介绍，并一键复制安装提示词。主页由 **GitHub Pages** 托管，随 `main` 分支的相关更新自动部署。维护与发布方法见[主页说明](docs/website.md)。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Token 数来自 DSH 的 usage 事件；金额由本地配置单价计算，是费用估算，不是权威账单。供应商可能随时调价，请始终以供应商实际账单为准。

readme.section: 一枚安静的价格标签，需要时再展开
readme.text: 输入框下方只显示当前或上一次任务的 `¥` 金额；点开后才有模型、输入 / 输出 / 缓存 token、模型调用次数、峰谷与时序累计，不再重复输入框旁已有的 token 与缓存信息，也不会占满整行。

readme.section: 价格和累计始终由你掌控
readme.text:
在 **设置 → 开销监控** 中编辑模型单价、添加自定义模型、启用官方峰谷计价、查看按模型累计，并导入或导出配置。

> 截图来自早期 v4.3 实例，仍是旧版全宽横条。`v5.1.0` 已改为紧凑 pill，并使用下文 2026-10-28 核对的官方价；图片会在下次采集后更新。

- **基于真实用量，不猜提示词大小**：读取 DSH usage 中的输入、输出、缓存命中和缓存写入 token，并覆盖重试 / 中断的请求。
- **实时且一眼可见**：把本次任务金额放在输入框下方；点开看 token 构成与会话累计。
- **支持子代理汇总**：子代理用量回卷到根会话当前轮次，并按每次调用实际使用的模型计价。
- **重启可恢复**：首次查看某个会话时，从持久事件日志重建历史。
- **价格可审计**：所有模型单价和峰谷时段都能在设置页查看和修改。
- **中英双语**：价格标签与设置页跟随 DSH 通用设置的语言（中文 / English）自动切换。
- **完全本地**：无遥测、无外部服务、无账号访问，不收集 API Key。
- **零执行干预**：没有预测门禁、确认遮罩或模型路由。

`dsh-cost-guard` 是一个 Cordis **bundle**：`package.json` 用 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明 Host 行，用 `dsh.client` 声明浏览器半部分。按 DSH 安装任何 bundle 的方式安装即可：

1. 把本仓库放到一个固定目录，例如 `D:\plugins\dsh-cost-guard`；
2. 打开 DSH 的 **设置 → 插件 → 组合包**，从本地目录安装；或使用等价的命令行：

```sh
   dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "D:\plugins\dsh-cost-guard"
   ```

3. 安装器报告 `restart-required` 时重启 DSH。

也可以直接让 DSH 智能体安装：

```text
把 D:\plugins\dsh-cost-guard 这个 DSH bundle 安装到当前 profile，
然后在插件清单里确认 cost-guard 这一行已经激活。
```

安装后 **设置 → 插件** 中会出现 **开销监控**，输入框下方出现一枚紧凑的价格标签。无需构建：两个半部分都是纯 JavaScript。

本地开发时把上面的路径换成 checkout 目录即可，安装器会以链接方式装入，改动后重新安装并重启生效。

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1+`（桌面版或 `dsh web`），profile 需包含 Web 应用组合包。
- 价格标签和设置页需要 DSH Web UI。
- 只有开发时跑 `npm run check` 才需要 Node.js。

`v5.1.0` 默认值与 **2026-10-28** 核对的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash / V4 Pro 官方峰谷定价一致（[DeepSeek API 官方定价页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/)、[2026-09-10 调价更新](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/updates/)）；单位为人民币元 / 1M tokens，下为谷时价：

| 模型 | 输入·缓存未命中 | 输出 | 输入·缓存命中 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `deepseek-flash` | ¥1.00 | ¥4.00 | ¥0.02 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | ¥4.50 | ¥13.50 | ¥0.15 |
| `default` 兜底 | ¥1.00 | ¥4.00 | ¥0.02 |

高峰时段为北京时间周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），单价为谷价的 2 倍；周末与法定节假日全天为谷时。2026 年节假日安排已内置。峰谷计价**默认开启**，可在设置页关闭或修改窗口与倍率。

官方表格没有单列缓存写入价，因此缓存写入 token 按输入缓存未命中价计算。旧名称会映射到当前计费行：`deepseek-v4-flash`、`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` → `deepseek-flash`，`deepseek-reasoner` → `deepseek-v4-pro`；已停用的 `deepseek-chat` 也映射到 Flash。

Search / Fetch 由 DeepSeek 另行按次计费（2026-11-01 起 ¥5 / 千次成功请求）。开销监控只统计模型 token，不含这部分请求费。

```mermaid flowchart LR A["session/event
turn/start · request/context"] --> B["session/event
assistant/message · assistant/attempt"] B --> C["配置单价
计算本地估算"] C --> D["轮次与模型累计"]

- **Host 半部分**（`index.js`）注入 `webServer`，折叠已入日志的会话事件、归属轮次、汇总子代理，首次查看时回填历史，并提供两条数据路由与一条健康检查路由。
- **Client 半部分**（`client.js`）是 `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle，在 `conversation.composer.dock` 注册价格标签、在 `settings.section` 注册设置页，并通过 `fetch` 读取 Host。
- **数据流**只留在当前 DSH 进程内；路由是本机 HTTP，不访问外部网络。
- **价格状态**持久化到 `~/.dsh/cost-guard/config.json`（识别 `$DSH_HOME`），重启后仍在。

打开 **设置 → 开销监控**：

| 区块 | 可配置内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 模型定价 | 输入未命中、输出、输入命中单价；自定义模型；恢复默认（两步确认） |
| 峰谷计价 | 周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（北京时间）×2，不含 2026 年法定节假日；周末 / 节假日全谷时 |
| 本次运行累计 | 已结算轮次、实际累计、可编辑汇率、按模型统计 |
| 配置备份 | JSON 导出与导入 |

明细中的美元金额使用可编辑的人民币 / 美元汇率近似换算。界面文字跟随 DSH 通用设置的语言（中文 / English）自动切换。

bundle 整体替换。更新方式：

1. 把安装目录里的文件换成新版本（或拉取新 release）；
2. 在 **设置 → 插件** 重新安装，或再次执行 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <路径>`；
3. 安装器报告 `restart-required` 时重启 DSH；Host 与浏览器 bundle 都会从新文件重新加载。

- 不发起外部请求，不含遥测，不读取凭据，不存储 API Key。
- Host 观察 DSH 会话 usage，并回放持久会话事件以重建累计。
- 导入配置通过校验后才会替换当前设置。
- DSH 插件接口仍在快速演进，请在安装第三方插件前审查源码。

安全问题反馈方式见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

| [`index.js`](index.js) | Host 半部分：会话折叠、计价、HTTP 路由 |
| [`client.js`](client.js) | Client 半部分：价格标签与设置页 bundle |
| [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) | 插入 Host 行的 bundle patch |
| [`locale/`](locale) | 插件清单展示用的标题与描述 |

| [`docs/install.md`](docs/install.md) | 安装、校验与卸载 |

| [`scripts/check.cjs`](scripts/check.cjs) | bundle 布局、语法与发布不变量检查 |
| [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) | 版本记录 |

```sh
npm run check
```

检查脚本会导入 Host 模块、以脚本方式编译 Client bundle，并核对 bundle 清单、patch、展示元数据与发布事实。想验证改动时直接把 checkout 目录装进 profile，重启后两个半部分都会重新加载。
